finding: A plain GET of the Microsoft Learn MCP endpoint, keyless, answers 405 with an HTML page that explains what the endpoint is. The vendor's own overview page predicts exactly this outcome in those words, so the claim is measured and true. It is recorded because a registry that lists MCP endpoints has to say what a non-MCP request to one does: this one is a courteous 405 with a human-readable explanation, where the Shopify UCP endpoint in this registry answers a plain GET with a 404 and the reason has to be looked up.
